accessibility.title: Make GYLIO comfortable to use
accessibility.subtitle: Neutral defaults are already selected. Change only what helps.
accessibility.helper: Choose what feels comfortable. These are interface preferences, not medical recommendations.
accessibility.textStyleHelper: Text size and spacing can affect comfort differently from person to person. Choose the version that works best for you.
accessibility.contrastHelper: Higher contrast can make text and controls easier to distinguish for some people; others prefer the regular theme.
accessibility.motionHelper: Following your device respects its reduced-motion setting. Reduce motion if animation distracts you or causes discomfort.
accessibility.ttsHelper: Optional. Research in students with reading difficulties finds a small average comprehension benefit from read-aloud or text-to-speech support, but effects vary between readers.
accessibility.evidenceBody: GYLIO follows accessibility standards for motion, resizing, contrast and user control. Reading supports can help some people but do not work the same way for everyone. We do not infer settings from a diagnosis.

quickSetup.title: Start with something useful
quickSetup.subtitle: Adding a first task is optional. Skip it if you would rather explore first.
quickSetup.helper: If you want, add one concrete thing you would like to do first.
quickSetup.goalPlaceholder: Example: Put tomorrow's documents by the door
quickSetup.goalHint: Make it specific and doable so the next action is clear. This is optional; use it only if it helps you get started.

tour.title: Know where things are
tour.subtitle: A short map of the app before you start.
tour.helper: You can finish immediately. Nothing on this screen is a consent or eligibility requirement.

items.tasks: Tasks — capture work and choose the next small action.
items.calendar: Calendar — place tasks and events in time.
items.budget: Budget — give income a job using your own categories.
items.rewards: Rewards — optional progress feedback you control.

tour.guideLater: The interactive Guide is available after setup, so you do not need to memorize this now.
